name: dsh-guava-pack
description: One portable DSH bundle: phone UI, direct/SSR provider router, theme manager, a customized Cyberpunk 2077 theme, an OpenCode session-header fix, a model-driven context-compaction backend (ACP), plus the CommandCode bridge service. Install once, works anywhere.
